861:t_000:3.en:
$$アマタ$$
「I'm the type who trains all my units evenly in Super Robot Wars.」

861:t_000:4.en:
$$アマタ$$
「But this time, thinking about who to pair up in teams keeps me up all niiiight!」

861:t_000:5.en:
$$アマタ$$
「Next time on '3rd Super Robot Wars Z': 'The Forbidden Tag Team'.」

861:t_000:6.en:
$$アマタ$$
「What am I really supposed to do...!?」

861:t_001:3.en:
$$アンディ$$
「You've worked hard! Now, would you like to join me for the ultimate way to unwind?」

861:t_001:5.en:
$$アンディ$$
「Of course I do! The destination of a man's soul... is digging holes...!」

861:t_001:7.en:
$$ＭＩＸ$$
「Everyone playing, I've sealed away $$アンディ$$, space and all, so he can't drag you down the path of evil.」

861:t_001:8.en:
$$ＭＩＸ$$
「Don't think about silly things like digging holes. Get some proper rest.」

861:t_001:9.en:
$$ＭＩＸ$$
「...For the sake of $$アンディ$$'s departed soul, too...」

861:t_001:10.en:
$$アンディ$$
「Don't just kill me off!」

861:t_002:3.en:
$$シュレード$$
「My dear friend... Give a message to the players taking a break.」

861:t_002:4.en:
$$カイエン$$
「I'll leave that sort of thing to you. Play them that violin you're so good at.」

861:t_002:5.en:
$$シュレード$$
「Heh... Beneath that cold demeanor, you appreciate my music, and even ask me to share it with the players...」

861:t_002:6.en:
$$シュレード$$
「You're what they call a tsundere.」

861:t_002:7.en:
$$カイエン$$
「Shut up! Besides, no one's happy to see you and me turn up somewhere like this!」

861:t_002:8.en:
$$シュレード$$
「That doesn't seem to be the case, does it?」

861:t_002:9.en:
$$サザンカ$$
「Oh, hearing $$シュレード$$ and $$カイエン$$ banter makes my head spin! I think I'll get a nosebleed!」

861:t_002:10.en:
$$カイエン$$
「How is anyone supposed to get a break like this!?」

861:t_003:3.en:
$$カグラ$$
「What, you're stopping here? Damn, you're one weak bastard...」

861:t_003:4.en:
$$カグラ$$
「If you're a man, you go at it till morning... If you're a woman, you go at it all night... right?」

861:t_003:5.en:
$$カグラ$$
「That's fine. I'll let you put off all that fun until the next battle.」

861:t_004:3.en:
$$クレア$$
「$$不動$$... I think I'll take a break too.」

861:t_004:4.en:
$$不動$$
「Then would you like a donut to replenish your sugar?」

861:t_004:5.en:
$$クレア$$
「You have a donut...? Where do you have anything like that?」

861:t_004:6.en:
$$不動$$
「This is the void at the center of a donut... In other words, it is the possibility of a donut...」

861:t_004:7.en:
$$不動$$
「That is, what makes a donut a donut is the infinite future arising from this spot...!」

861:t_004:8.en:
$$クレア$$
「...Do you think that explanation will satisfy me?」

861:t_004:9.en:
$$不動$$
「Heh... It seems the players agree with you. Until we meet again!」

861:t_005:3.en:
$$サザンカ$$
「Hey, customer, customer! I've got some great photos! Do you see anything you want?」

861:t_005:4.en:
$$サザンカ$$
「Do you want $$ミコノ$$? $$ゼシカ$$? $$ＭＩＸ$$? I've got $$ユノハ$$, Chairwoman $$クレア$$, and Instructor $$スオミ$$ too!」

861:t_005:5.en:
$$サザンカ$$
「Or would you rather have... m-e?」

861:t_005:6.en:
$$サザンカ$$
「...I'm just kidding. Oh, I wish there were someone out there who only had eyes for me!」

861:t_006:3.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「Oh, you're stopping here? That's a shame. I wanted you to play some more.」

861:t_006:4.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「With my help, you could max out your funds or obtain secret units as you pleased...」

861:t_006:5.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「That's fine. I'll grant your wishes another time. Until then...」

861:t_007:3.en:
$$モロイ$$
「Fraaaagile! Fraaaagile! And fraaaagile! One more fraaaagile!」

861:t_007:4.en:
$$サザンカ$$
「Wh-what are you doing, $$モロイ$$?」

861:t_007:5.en:
$$モロイ$$
「I'm shattering the player's resolve to study or go to work. That should make them want to keep playing.」

861:t_007:6.en:
$$サザンカ$$
「In that case, I'll rot away the player's motivation!」

861:t_007:8.en:
$$サザンカ$$
「Rot, rot, rot...! Rot, rot, rot, rot, rot...!」

861:t_007:10.en:
$$サザンカ$$
「Rot, rot, rot! Rot, rot, rot, rot, rot!」

861:t_008:3.en:
$$ミコノ$$
「You're taking a break too, players? I look forward to the day we meet again.」

861:t_008:4.en:
$$アマタ$$
「Um, uh... $$ミコノ$$...! Would you like to go see a movie during our break?」

861:t_008:5.en:
$$ミコノ$$
「Uh... um... If you're sure you want to go with me...」

861:t_008:6.en:
$$ゼシカ$$
「OK! Then let's all go together!」

861:t_008:9.en:
$$アマタ$$
「...Sorry, $$ゼシカ$$. I... want to go with just $$ミコノ$$.」

861:t_008:11.en:
$$ゼシカ$$
「Ahaha, I was just teasing, $$アマタ$$! Have fun on your date with $$ミコノ$$.」

861:t_008:12.en:
$$ゼシカ$$
「Whew... So, that's how it is. You players will have to console me.」

861:t_009:3.en:
$$ユノハ$$
「$$ジン$$, what are you doing here?」

861:t_009:4.en:
$$ジン$$
「I-it's not like I was thinking about what combining is like or anything!」

861:t_009:5.en:
$$ユノハ$$
「...Oh, I know. Would you like to play Super Robot Wars together now?」

861:t_009:6.en:
$$ユノハ$$
「It's really a single-player game, but I've never played it, so I'd like you to teach me.」

861:t_009:8.en:
$$ジン$$
(Ah... Could this fluttering feeling... be combining...?)

861:t_010:3.en:
$$アマタ$$
「You've worked hard, everyone. Get plenty of rest until the next time you play.」

861:t_010:4.en:
$$カグラ$$
「What the hell was that limp greeting!? Have you got any killer instinct!? Show them some backbone!」

861:t_010:5.en:
$$アマタ$$
「Now you've said it, $$カグラ$$! Let's see you give a proper greeting!」

861:t_010:6.en:
$$カグラ$$
「Heh! There's nothing I can't do!」

861:t_010:7.en:
$$アマタ$$
「I can do it too, if I put my mind to it!」

861:t_010:8.en:
$$カグラ$$
「Dear players, I'll... Ahem, I will be awaiting your return!」

861:t_010:9.en:
$$アマタ$$
「Don't keep us waiting too long! Turarararara!」

861:t_011:3.en:
$$アポロ$$
「What, what!? You're quitting here!? I still haven't had my fill!」

861:t_011:4.en:
$$シリウス$$
「Stop that, $$アポロ$$! Not everyone is as tough as you!」

861:t_011:5.en:
$$シルヴィア$$
「That's right! Don't lump us in with $$アポロ$$!」

861:t_011:6.en:
$$アポロ$$
「Hah! I don't want to hear that from a stupid princess with freakish strength!」

861:t_011:7.en:
$$シリウス$$
「I won't allow you to insult my sister!!」

861:t_011:8.en:
$$アポロ$$
「And I don't want to hear it from $$シリウス$$, either! You keep nervously resetting the game!」

861:t_011:9.en:
$$シルヴィア$$
「Brother! You said playing with resets meant you couldn't accept defeat!?」
